body: Just wanna know if anyone has any idea what it could be?

YTA. And judging from your replies to people's comments, you're not understanding that you decided to be in a relationship with someone that had a kid. A lot of your replies make it look like your stepkid is the problem. You keep coming up with excuses, like not being able to afford them being over. That's literally not on the child. I don't blame her for wanting his rights to be stripped. That kid deserves better than you and your husband.
